entities.name: Kotara
entities.description: An angel summoned by Sabul Hajeen to kill a murderer, who falls and finally sacrifices herself against a demon.

entities.name: Sabul Hajeen
entities.description: A civic guildmage in Ki'pamu who summons Kotara to avenge his brother.

entities.name: Finroy of Tyarel
entities.description: An apprentice of Lord Rothchild who covers for him.

entities.name: Lord Rothchild
entities.description: The lord of Jornstad, a beloved public speaker who is a drunkard in private.

entities.name: Edgur
entities.description: A coppersmith's apprentice who bargains with the nature spirit Dare for the ability to become a bear.

entities.name: Temken
entities.description: An elf of the Survivors who finds Gwenna and leads elves to safety.

entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: The elf whose actions let Urza and Mishra discover Argoth, who sacrifices her life to trap a shadow being.

entities.name: Armand Ar-basinno
entities.description: A disrespected archaeologist who interprets the Flarg goblins' game of cricket as a religious ritual.

entities.name: Latavino Bar-bassanti
entities.description: A scholar who disagrees with Armand and identifies cricket as a game.

entities.name: Elkan
entities.description: A Balduvian mage who goads the orc general Jonar into battle intending the orcs to die.

entities.name: Groth Jonar
entities.description: An orcish general who kills Elkan and claims the Kjeldoran battle standard.

entities.name: Tayva
entities.description: A cousin of Loria, a former socialite taught black magic who kills for fun.

entities.name: Loria
entities.description: A cousin of Tayva who also kills for fun.

entities.name: Crucias
entities.description: An unscrupulous ship's captain who survives the Sylex Blast and later ascends as the planeswalker Bo Levar.

entities.name: Elgia
entities.description: The niece of lady Gheiri who survives the blast below decks.

entities.name: Nunieve
entities.description: Crucias's daughter, who died at nine.

entities.name: Damon
entities.description: An apprentice who fails a mirror test but kills a Stromgald assassin and realizes he is already a wizard.

entities.name: Master Wane
entities.description: Damon's master, a wizard who aided the Kjeldorans.

entities.name: Annise
entities.description: A casino worker who leaves her self-centered boyfriend.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A believer in the Third Way who tries to resurrect his wife Loran with magic.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Feldon's wife, whose resurrection yields a false copy.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The war-torn world where the anthology's stories take place.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: An island devastated by the war of the Brothers.

entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: The home of the goblins studied by Armand.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The explosion that destroyed Argoth and the ship Crucias captained.

events.summary: Sabul Hajeen summons the angel Kotara to kill the murderer of his brother Axdan, then has her kill the killer's accomplices and relatives.
events.quote: After that, he starts having her kill accomplices and relatives of the killer.

events.summary: Kotara, now a fallen angel, returns and sacrifices her life so that Sabul can kill a demon summoned by the killer's family.
events.quote: Thus she returns and sacrifices her life so Sabul, who has seen the error of his ways, has the time to cast a killing spell on the demon.

events.summary: Finroy covers for Lord Rothchild and accidentally lures the Scaled Wurm to a village, which chases it off.
events.quote: but he accidentally lures it to a village where the villagers chase it off.

events.summary: Edgur gains the ability to turn into a bear, kills his rival Joren, and is killed by townsfolk.
events.quote: But the townsfolk, seeing only a dangerous predatory animal, then converge on Edgur, killing him.

events.summary: Temken convinces Gwenna to help trap the malevolent shadow in the bayou; Gwenna dies, letting Temken lead the elves to safety.
events.quote: Together, Temken and Gwenna fight the shadow being and succeed in trapping it, although Gwenna sacrifices her life in the process.

events.summary: Evidence suggests the goblins' cricket obsession spiraled into a civil war that wiped them out.
events.quote: leading to a civil war that wiped out the goblins, leaving only ruins.

events.summary: Jonar sends the goblins against the Kjeldorans first, then attacks, routing the knights; he kills Elkan when he intervenes.
events.quote: Jonar kills him and then lets the remaining knights leave without further harm

events.summary: Tayva and Loria each try to kill the other and the lake spirit's reanimated Winton drags both into the water.
events.quote: he drags both of them into the waters.

events.summary: Crucias's passengers witness the Sylex Blast; everyone on deck dies except Crucias, who is blinded.
events.quote: Everyone on deck dies except Crucias himself, who is blinded by the blast.

events.summary: Crucias and Elgia survive; Crucias later ascends as the planeswalker Bo Levar.
events.quote: Crucias would later ascend as a planeswalker and change his name to Bo Levar .

events.summary: Damon kills a Stromgald assassin by using the mirror to make her believe she is a healer, and learns he is already a wizard.
events.quote: The ordeal makes Damon realize what his master meant when he said he would never become a wizard - because he was already a wizard.

events.summary: Annise distracts the casino boss's opponent, causing him to lose and be bankrupted.
Feldon revives Loran with magic but she is not the real Loran, and he lets her go.
events.quote: Feldon says goodbye to her and lets her go.
